_about: tools/ted_maps.py build: T-Edition 3.0.7's new maps (416-510) as PR maps. Per map: how (clone: a copy of the PR room(s) of the vanilla map with its layout, cells its entrance event redraws patched in; convert: drawn by snes_rooms from vanilla rooms that look alike), its rooms (PR map name/id/group, PR = SNES + (dx, dy)), points (PointIn object ids by spot: ChangeMap [pr_id, point_id]), exits (as GotoMaps), chests (flag_id: the PR treasure flag), npcs and events (SNES records with their PR spots; event = SNES address). into: exits on vanilla maps that lead into new maps (doors added to the PR maps in additions). warps: event map loads into new maps (SNES map, x, y, facing): each has a point. unresolved: exits with no PR target (to the parent map 0x1FF, or a place without a PR map).
